title: Smoke: Fine-grained Lineage at Interactive Speed
citation: Fotis Psallidas and Eugene Wu · VLDB 2018
note: If someone clicks a chart to inspect a result, rerunning the original query can be too slow. Smoke shows how recording row relationships during execution can make that later interaction fast.

title: DuckDB: an Embeddable Analytical Database
citation: Mark Raasveldt and Hannes Mühleisen · SIGMOD 2019
note: Analytical queries don't require a separate database server. DuckDB brings a vectorized engine into the application process, the same execution model my thesis extended to answer lineage queries.
